Usage: gotools sync [options]

  Sync tool state to match .gotools.json. Tidies existing modfiles and
  reinstalls any tools from the manifest that are missing on disk or whose
  installed version drifted from the manifest.

  If the on-disk strategy doesn't match the manifest, auto-migrates.

  Fast path: when nothing changed, a state fingerprint in
  $GOTOOLS_DIR/.gotools.fingerprint skips the reconciliation entirely. Commit
  that file so fresh clones are fast too.

  Examples:
    gotools sync
    gotools sync --dry-run
    gotools sync --jobs 4
    gotools sync --offline

  Options:
    --dry-run     Show what would be done without making changes
    --offline     Hermetic: fingerprint match only, exit 6 otherwise (GOTOOLS_OFFLINE=1 does the same)
    --jobs <int>  Reinstall N tools at a time; split and module only (GOTOOLS_JOBS=N does the same) (default: 1)
